{{Top|leg}}
The '''power cell system''' was an advanced energy conservation system developed by [[Publictechnic]] and installed on their [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Due to the large power requirements of the droid, the system stored a small portion of energy for every operational hour. This increased the droid's self-sufficiency.
